title: An Interview With Intuit CEO Sasan Goodarzi About Accounting and AI
author: Ben Thompson
description: An interview with Intuit CEO Sasan Goodarzi about the working for one of tech's oldest software companies, and how Intuit is leaning into the AI paradigm shift.
summary: Listen to this post: Good morning, This week’s Stratechery Interview is with Intuit CEO Sasan Goodarzi . Goodarzi took a very non-traditional path to Silicon Valley, joining Intuit in 2004 after working at Siemens and Honeywell.
takeaways: We also touch on acquisitions like Credit Karma and Mailchimp, and how Intuit has managed business model changes in the past, and what needs to change in the future.
After managing business units across the company he became CEO in 2019, and is taking on the challenge of figuring out how one of tech’s oldest software companies manages the AI paradigm shift.
In this interview we discuss Goodarzi’s background and the what it takes to be an effective generalist, and get his take on how Intuit has thrived for 44 years.
